figurative_meaning_en: The end of suffering, an extremely painful and excruciating ordeal
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার জীবনের শেষ দিনগুলো ছিল ভোগান্তির মতো দুঃখের।
example_sentences_in_english: The last days of his life were like an agony of suffering.
The final phase of the war brought excruciating torment.
note: This idiom often conveys the culmination of prolonged hardship in Bengali literature and everyday expressions.
